sloka: स्वागतम् ते रघु श्रेष्ठ राम सत्यभृताम् वर ।आश्रमओ अयम् त्वया आक्रान्तः सनाथ इव सांप्रतम् ॥३-७-८॥
transliteration: svāgatam te raghu śreṣṭha rāma satyabhṛtām vara ।āśramao ayam tvayā ākrāntaḥ sanātha iva sāṁpratam ॥3-7-8॥

translations.english: O Rama, the best among the Raghavas and among the upholders of truth, you are welcome. With your presence this hermitage will have a protector now.
